verdict.rationale: SavvyCal workflows send customized meeting lifecycle messages. They attach to one or more scheduling links, support multi-action sequences, and let users set reminder timing and content (with templates) explicitly to minimize no-shows and increase attendance. Missing for 10: no evidence of SMS as a channel, email delivery is only implied, post-meeting follow-up messages are not explicitly documented, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration.
